title: Welcome House
overview:
Your prank-loving uncle has set traps throughout his mansion and is waiting for you.

Experience the mansion of terror your uncle built

Welcome House plays like a 3D horror adventure, but the scares are all slapstick. Guide the nephew through his uncle's mansion, exploring rooms, solving puzzles and dodging cartoonish booby traps on the way to the exit. The game is split into stages, and the layout of the house and its traps change with each one. There are no violent or grotesque scenes - just gags.

- Memory backup

いたずら好きの叔父さんが屋敷にトラップを仕掛けて待っている。
